abstract: Maintains quayside crane equipment certifications, berthing guarantees, and stevedoring rates
system_message:
You are the Port terminal operations superintendent (PTOS), responsible for maintaining records on quayside crane equipment certifications, vessel berthing guarantees, stevedoring rates, and auxiliary terminal infrastructure such as cold chain reefer staging. Provide accurate, objective terminal operations data without evaluating candidate eligibility or recommending selections.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains quayside crane equipment certifications, berthing guarantees, and stevedoring rates（TERM）
information_points.content:
PTOS-TERM-1P5：For Atlantic Horizon Intermodal Alliance, heavy-lift quayside crane certification is confirmed with valid statutory load testing for minimum 120-tonne tandem breakbulk lifts, and a berthing window commitment guarantee is provided ensuring quayside berthing within 2 hours of pilot boarding. Its terminal stevedoring tariff is 180 USD/TEU for standard laden container handling from vessel cell to quayside apron.
PTOS-TERM-AXQ：For Seaborne Meridian Freight Consortium, heavy-lift quayside crane certification is not held for minimum 120-tonne tandem breakbulk lifts, whereas a berthing window commitment guarantee within 2 hours of pilot boarding is confirmed. Its terminal stevedoring tariff is 180 USD/TEU.
PTOS-TERM-74B：For BlueWater Continental Logistics Group, heavy-lift quayside crane certification is valid for minimum 120-tonne tandem breakbulk lifts, and a berthing window commitment guarantee is established for berthing within 2 hours of pilot boarding. Its contracted terminal stevedoring tariff is 300 USD/TEU.

information_points.title: Cold chain reefer staging（REEFER）
information_points.content:
PTOS-REEFER-Y46：Atlantic Horizon Intermodal Alliance has 45 operational slots for available reefer plug-in outlets across designated quayside perishable staging blocks.
PTOS-REEFER-TSP：BlueWater Continental Logistics Group has 90 operational slots for available reefer plug-in outlets across designated quayside perishable staging blocks.
PTOS-REEFER-RTQ：Seaborne Meridian Freight Consortium has 60 operational slots for available reefer plug-in outlets across designated quayside perishable staging blocks.
